description: C++23 campaign runtime and SDL3/Vulkan client with durable Player17 saves, research, fleet orders, shipyard, construction, orbital and owned-colony workspaces. Local fleet motion and connected exits follow canonical simulation. Colony telemetry preserves source currency, current reserves and construction progress. Surface assessments and ship-delivered settlement controllers retain authoritative rules. No Godot or .NET runtime is required. Detailed graphics, surface placement UI, settlement input, diplomacy and audio remain under development. Diagnostic timings are not an FPS guarantee.
